instruction: Worker A can finish a job alone in 6 hours. Worker B can finish the same job alone in 12 hours. Working together, how many hours do they need to finish the job? Give the answer in whole hours, rounded to the nearest integer. Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
